response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph quoting Acts 27:20 (source.html first long paragraph after heading)","severity":"minor","source_quote":"…when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away –Acts 27:20.","suggested_fix":"Replace awkward phrasing “is toenemend weggeneem” with a clearer, faithful Afrikaans rendering of the English: e.g. “...toe al die hoop dat ons gered sou word van ons geneem is – Handelinge 27:20.” Preserve verse reference formatting and punctuation.","translation_quote":"…al die hoop dat ons gered sou word is toenemend weggeneem –Handelinge 27:20."},{"location":"Paragraph quoting 2 Corinthians 1:8 (source.html, paragraph beginning “If there first be no valley…”)","severity":"minor","source_quote":"…pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life –2 Corinthians 1:8.","suggested_fix":"The Afrikaans rendering is awkward and slightly unclear: replace “byna tot niks toe bedrieg en baie swaar benoud is, so dat ons selfs die lewe hopeloos geag het” with a closer, idiomatic translation that preserves the sense, e.g. “…so erg verdring en bo krag, dat ons selfs die lewe hopeloos geag het – 2 Korintiërs 1:8.”","translation_quote":"…byna tot niks toe bedrieg en baie swaar benoud is, so dat ons selfs die lewe hopeloos geag het –2 Korintiërs 1:8."},{"location":"Paragraph beginning “Ons geloof is bound to fail…” (source.html paragraph about anxiety escalating)","severity":"minor","source_quote":"Our faith is bound to fail when anxiety escalates, and we think we must control the raging trials about us.","suggested_fix":"The translation uses “Ons geloof is voorbestan om te faal”, which is an incorrect wording in Afrikaans. Suggest: “Ons geloof is geneig om te faal wanneer angs eskaleer, en ons dink ons moet die woedende beproewings rondom ons beheer.”","translation_quote":"Ons geloof is voorbestan om te faal wanneer angs eskaleer en ons dink ons moet die woedende beproewings rondom ons beheer."}],"passed":true,"score":97}
